release.inspection: Official DMG downloaded, SHA-256 matched release API digest, mounted read-only locally without opening app. Version/build/revision read from Info.plist. The native application was subsequently exercised on a disposable GitHub-hosted macOS runner, never on the user's desktop.

measurement_boundaries.pty_byte_echo: Not applicable to native GUI; CLI command acknowledgement is not terminal rendering.
measurement_boundaries.native_startup: One LaunchServices invocation per campaign to a command completion marker returned by read-screen; includes CLI startup and polling, not a cold-cache boot.
measurement_boundaries.native_memory: Main-app and captured process-tree RSS recorded after the command probes; excludes shared WindowServer, GPU allocations and unattributed helpers, may double-count shared pages, and is not physical footprint or server-only RSS.
measurement_boundaries.input_to_pixel: Unmeasured: requires a presentation receipt or controlled visual instrumentation; no timing inferred from socket acknowledgement.

isolation_review.supported_route: Upstream tagged Release staging changes bundle identity, socket and daemon socket, ad-hoc signs the copied app, then invokes open -g.
isolation_review.local_session_blocker: The inspected release's startup calls scheduleInitialMainWindowBootstrap -> bootstrapInitialMainWindowIfNeeded with shouldActivate defaulting true. createMainWindow uses runningApplication([activateAllWindows]) and respectActivationSuppression:false. open -g alone therefore does not prove non-activation. No native launch was attempted on the user's active GUI session.
isolation_review.state_warning: Upstream staging script resolves account home via getpwuid for discovery markers; changing HOME alone does not isolate all macOS preferences/state.
isolation_review.required_environment: Dedicated macOS login/VM or explicitly available GUI test session, owned sockets/state/workspace, no global accessibility changes. The disposable runner used the official bundle identity; tagged bundle isolation is needed when sharing an existing desktop.

native_experiment.comparison_limit: Different host and CLI-observation boundary from the phux/tmux/Herdr PTY campaign; no cross-product numerical ranking.
